answer: We formalize Sybil resistance through dynamic opportunity-cost bonds that bridge individual stake to systemic stability. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix ensures any pearl of arbitrage is counteracted by a glacier of loss-inducing penalties across the attacker's distributed identities. By integrating zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions with escalating staking requirements, the expected utility of an adversary remains strictly negative. This mechanism guarantees convergence toward a robust Nash equilibrium in adversarial multi-agent environments.
